title: Vuelta a España Stage 1: Pogačar Pips Hayter by 0.09 Seconds to Take First Red Jersey
content:
Incredibly tight battle sees Tadej Pogačar scoop first red jersey of Vuelta on adopted home soil, beating Ethan Hayter by tiny margin.

Read the full article at Vuelta a España Stage 1: Pogačar Pips Hayter by 0.09 Seconds to Take First Red Jersey on Velo.
